newsitem.title: USA: U.S. West Coast prods fell with lower NYMEX prices.
newsitem.headline: U.S. West Coast prods fell with lower NYMEX prices.

text.p: U.S. West Coast spot product prices fell with lower crude and gasoline futures Friday, with few bids heard and deals completed, brokers said.
April NYMEX crude fell 14 cents to $21.55 a barrel at 1200 PST, while March gasoline dropped 0.48 cents a gallon to 62.30 cents a gallon.
"No one wants to buy or sell in this market," a broker said. "We're lower across the board today."
CARB gasoline in Los Angeles fell a half cent to 72.50/73.50 cents a gallon Friday.
